TEXT.source: ['15. kavavatanen no tazokok', 'tazokok鳥的故事', 'The story of the tazokok bird', '', 'si apen Yohani (F, 49, Iranmilek)', '江秀玉，女，49，東清村', '']

S.FORM: kavavatanen no tazokok nokakoa ori am, maci-lolo o anak na do ina na ori am.
S.PHON: kavavatanən n[o|u] taʐ[o|u]k[o|u]k n[o|u]kak[o|u]a [o|u]ri am macil[o|u]l[o|u] [o|u] anak na ɖ[o|u] ina na [o|u]ri am
S.FORM: kavavatanen no tazokok nokakoa ori am, macilolo o anak na do ina na ori am.
S.PHON: kafafatanən n[o|u] tar[o|u]k[o|u]k n[o|u]kak[o|u]a [o|u]ɻi am maʨil[o|u]l[o|u] [o|u] anak na ɖ[o|u] ina na [o|u]ɻi am
S.TRANSL: 很久以前，有一個關於tazokok鳥的故事。一個小孩子想跟他的母親一起上山
There was a story of the tazokok bird. A child wanted to go with her mother into the mountains.

S.FORM: "ji ka ngai, mo koimo, ta to ka mang-ine-ynara so tazokok am, toktok-an na o mata mo no tazokok" koan na.
S.PHON: ʥi ka ŋai m[o|u] k[o|u]im[o|u] ta t[o|u] ka maŋinəjnara ʂ[o|u] taʐ[o|u]k[o|u]k am t[o|u]kt[o|u]kan na [o|u] mata m[o|u] n[o|u] taʐ[o|u]k[o|u]k k[o|u]an na
S.FORM: "ji ka ngai, mo koimo, ta to ka mangineynara so tazokok am, toktokan na o mata mo no tazokok" koan na.
S.PHON: ʥi ka ŋai m[o|u] k[o|u]im[o|u] ta t[o|u] ka maŋinəjnaɻa ʂ[o|u] tar[o|u]k[o|u]k am t[o|u]kt[o|u]kan na [o|u] mata m[o|u] n[o|u] tar[o|u]k[o|u]k k[o|u]an na
S.TRANSL: ＂喂，你不要跟來，因為你會模仿tazokok鳥叫聲，它們會挖了你的眼睛吃＂ 他說
"Hey, don't follow me, for you will copy the call of a tazokok bird and they will come and peck your eyes out.

S.FORM: "a ji abo a, ma-ngay ko jimo saon am" koan na am, ji na pa-sovay-i no niapoan na am, to na rana pa-lolo-a o anak na.
S.PHON: a ʥi ab[o|u] a maŋaj k[o|u] ʥim[o|u] ʂa[o|u]n am k[o|u]an na am ʥi na paʂ[o|u]vaji n[o|u] niap[o|u]an na am t[o|u] na rana pal[o|u]l[o|u]a [o|u] anak na
S.FORM: "a ji abo a, mangay ko jimo saon am" koan na am, ji na pasovayi no niapoan na am, to na rana paloloa o anak na.
S.PHON: a ʥi ab[o|u] a maŋaj k[o|u] ʥim[o|u] ʂa[o|u]n am k[o|u]an na am ʥi na paʂ[o|u]faji n[o|u] niap[o|u]an na am t[o|u] na ɻana pal[o|u]l[o|u]a [o|u] anak na
S.TRANSL: ＂不會啦，我要跟你去＂ 他說，他的母親拗不過他，就只好帶他一起上山去了
"No, I want to go with you." The mother could not dissuade her child, so she took her with her.

S.FORM: karaan am, ma-sasnad sira do yan-an da ori o mi-ina ori am, am-ian do ka-tangked da so "me, me, tazokok! tazokok!" koan na do ka-viao-an ori am, to na pa neleh-an ori no anak na ori a.
S.PHON: karaan am maʂaʂnaɖ ʂira ɖ[o|u] janan ɖa [o|u]ri [o|u] miina [o|u]ri am amian ɖ[o|u] kataŋkəɖ ɖa ʂ[o|u] mə mə taʐ[o|u]k[o|u]k taʐ[o|u]k[o|u]k k[o|u]an na ɖ[o|u] kavia[o|u]an [o|u]ri am t[o|u] na pa nələʁan [o|u]ri n[o|u] anak na [o|u]ri a
S.FORM: karaan am, masasnad sira do yanan da ori o miina ori am, amian do katangked da so "me, me, tazokok! tazokok!" koan na do kaviaoan ori am, to na pa nelehan ori no anak na ori a.
S.PHON: kaɻaan am maʂaʂnaɖ ɕiɻa ɖ[o|u] janan ɖa [o|u]ɻi [o|u] miina [o|u]ɻi am amian ɖ[o|u] kataŋkəɖ ɖa ʂ[o|u] mə mə tar[o|u]k[o|u]k tar[o|u]k[o|u]k k[o|u]an na ɖ[o|u] kafia[o|u]an [o|u]ɻi am t[o|u] na pa nələɰan [o|u]ɻi n[o|u] anak na [o|u]ɻi a
S.TRANSL: 他們母女倆到了目的地後，他們就聽到田邊的蘆葦叢裡有tazokok鳥＂嗯，嗯，tazokok,tazokok＂ 的叫聲。小孩子就當作沒有聽到
When the two of them got to the area, they heard a tazokok crying out from the reeds. "Un, un, tazokok, tazokok," it cried. The child didn't pay any attention.

S.FORM: ipí-doa so ka-pi-zi-ziak na ori a, "me, me, tazokok! tazokok!" koan na ori am.
S.PHON: ip*ɖ[o|u]a ʂ[o|u] kapiʐiʐiak na [o|u]ri a mə mə taʐ[o|u]k[o|u]k taʐ[o|u]k[o|u]k k[o|u]an na [o|u]ri am
S.FORM: ipidoa so kapiziziak na ori a, "me, me, tazokok! tazokok!" koan na ori am.
S.PHON: ipiɖ[o|u]a ʂ[o|u] kapiririak na [o|u]ɻi a mə mə tar[o|u]k[o|u]k tar[o|u]k[o|u]k k[o|u]an na [o|u]ɻi am
S.TRANSL: 第二次，tazokok鳥又＂嗯，嗯，tazokok！tazokok！＂ 叫的時候
The tazokok cried for a second time,"tazokok! tazokok!"

S.FORM: ma-níring o anak na ori am, "me, me, tazokok! tazokok!" koan na ori no anak na am.
S.PHON: man*riŋ [o|u] anak na [o|u]ri am mə mə taʐ[o|u]k[o|u]k taʐ[o|u]k[o|u]k k[o|u]an na [o|u]ri n[o|u] anak na am
S.FORM: maniring o anak na ori am, "me, me, tazokok! tazokok!" koan na ori no anak na am.
S.PHON: maniɻiŋ [o|u] anak na [o|u]ɻi am mə mə tar[o|u]k[o|u]k tar[o|u]k[o|u]k k[o|u]an na [o|u]ɻi n[o|u] anak na am
S.TRANSL: 小孩子就＂嗯，嗯，tazokok！tazokok！＂ 的模仿鳥在叫
"Un, un, tazokok, tazokok," the child copied the bird.

S.FORM: "taona, ji mo ng-in-inara-i koan ko imo ori, mo pi-aavoada, mi ta rana, mo pi-aavoada".
S.PHON: ta[o|u]na ʥi m[o|u] ŋininarai k[o|u]an k[o|u] im[o|u] [o|u]ri m[o|u] piaav[o|u]aɖa mi ta rana m[o|u] piaav[o|u]aɖa
S.FORM: "taona, ji mo ngininarai koan ko imo ori, mo piaavoada, mi ta rana, mo piaavoada".
S.PHON: ta[o|u]na ʥi m[o|u] ŋininaɻai k[o|u]an k[o|u] im[o|u] [o|u]ɻi m[o|u] piaaf[o|u]aɖa mi ta ɻana m[o|u] piaaf[o|u]aɖa
S.TRANSL: ＂啊喲，我不是跟你說過不可以模仿的嗎？真是的；走了！我們回家去＂
"Oh, I told you not to copy the bird, but you did. We have to go."

S.FORM: koan na no tazokok, mo ina am, "mo to ng-in-inara-i jiaken, ji abo ka-ji ko ang-sem-an so mata mo a" koan na.
S.PHON: k[o|u]an na n[o|u] taʐ[o|u]k[o|u]k m[o|u] ina am m[o|u] t[o|u] ŋininarai ʥiakən ʥi ab[o|u] kaʥi k[o|u] aŋʂəman ʂ[o|u] mata m[o|u] a k[o|u]an na
S.FORM: koan na no tazokok, mo ina am, "mo to ngininarai jiaken, ji abo kaji ko angseman so mata mo a" koan na.
S.PHON: k[o|u]an na n[o|u] tar[o|u]k[o|u]k m[o|u] ina am m[o|u] t[o|u] ŋininaɻai ʥiakən ʥi ab[o|u] kaʥi k[o|u] aŋʂəman ʂ[o|u] mata m[o|u] a k[o|u]an na
S.TRANSL: 媽，tazokok說＂你為什麼學我叫？，我非挖了你的眼睛吃不可＂ 它說
"Mom, tazokok told me, 'You copied me, now I am going to eat your eyeballs raw'.

S.FORM: "ta ori, mo pi-aavoada, ji ka ngai koan ko imo ori a, ji ka maci-'eza koan ko imo ori, mo ka-kmi cinoklan a, a ma-noyong ori a ciring no tazokok?"
S.PHON: ta [o|u]ri m[o|u] piaav[o|u]aɖa ʥi ka ŋai k[o|u]an k[o|u] im[o|u] [o|u]ri a ʥi ka maciʔəʐa k[o|u]an k[o|u] im[o|u] [o|u]ri m[o|u] kakmi cin[o|u]klan a a man[o|u]j[o|u]ŋ [o|u]ri a ciriŋ n[o|u] taʐ[o|u]k[o|u]k
S.FORM: "ta ori, mo piaavoada, ji ka ngai koan ko imo ori a, ji ka maci'eza koan ko imo ori, mo kakmi cinoklan a, a manoyong ori a ciring no tazokok?"
S.PHON: ta [o|u]ɻi m[o|u] piaaf[o|u]aɖa ʥi ka ŋai k[o|u]an k[o|u] im[o|u] [o|u]ɻi a ʥi ka maʨiʔəra k[o|u]an k[o|u] im[o|u] [o|u]ɻi m[o|u] kakmi ʨin[o|u]klan a a man[o|u]j[o|u]ŋ [o|u]ɻi a ʨiɻiŋ n[o|u] tar[o|u]k[o|u]k
S.TRANSL: ＂你看看，我說你不要來，你不要跟來的嘛，真是的。你剛才說的，tazokok鳥真的是這麼說嗎？＂
"I told you not to come, and not to follow. Is what the bird said for real?"

S.FORM: "nona, ya ji a-noyong a", "a mi ta rana, mo ka-vazat" koan na.
S.PHON: n[o|u]na ja ʥi an[o|u]j[o|u]ŋ a a mi ta rana m[o|u] kavaʐat k[o|u]an na
S.FORM: "nona, ya ji anoyong a", "a mi ta rana, mo kavazat" koan na.
S.PHON: n[o|u]na ja ʥi an[o|u]j[o|u]ŋ a a mi ta ɻana m[o|u] kafarat k[o|u]an na
S.TRANSL: ＂當然是真的啊＂ ，＂那我們快走吧，真是的＂ 他的母親說
"Of course it's real." "Then let's get out of here, idiot," her mother said.

S.FORM: to na rana pi-sin-sinmó-a no ina na o ni-key-kali na ori a, karaan am, m-oli rana sira.
S.PHON: t[o|u] na rana piʂinʂinm*a n[o|u] ina na [o|u] nikəjkali na [o|u]ri a karaan am m[o|u]li rana ʂira
S.FORM: to na rana pisinsinmoa no ina na o nikeykali na ori a, karaan am, moli rana sira.
S.PHON: t[o|u] na ɻana piɕinɕinm[o|u]a n[o|u] ina na [o|u] nikəjkali na [o|u]ɻi a kaɻaan am m[o|u]li ɻana ɕiɻa
S.TRANSL: 於是他的母親趕緊收拾他挖好的（芋頭/地瓜），然後他們就回家去了
Her mother packed everything up, including (the taro and sweet potato) they had dug up, and they went back home.

W.TRANSL: 動綴-疊-收拾集中-受焦.虛

S.FORM: karaan am, to da rana a-cíta o tazokok ori a maci-'eza jira a.
S.PHON: karaan am t[o|u] ɖa rana ac*ta [o|u] taʐ[o|u]k[o|u]k [o|u]ri a maciʔəʐa ʥira a
S.FORM: karaan am, to da rana acita o tazokok ori a maci'eza jira a.
S.PHON: kaɻaan am t[o|u] ɖa ɻana aʨita [o|u] tar[o|u]k[o|u]k [o|u]ɻi a maʨiʔəra ʥiɻa a
S.TRANSL: 不久，他們發現tazokok已經在跟隨他們來了
Afterwards, they found the tazokok had followed them.

S.FORM: "o ito rana, mo pi-aavoada, awalay!" to sia ma-la-láyo ori o mi-ina ori a.
S.PHON: [o|u] it[o|u] rana m[o|u] piaav[o|u]aɖa awalaj t[o|u] ʂia malal*j[o|u] [o|u]ri [o|u] miina [o|u]ri a
S.FORM: "o ito rana, mo piaavoada, awalay!" to sia malalayo ori o miina ori a.
S.PHON: [o|u] it[o|u] ɻana m[o|u] piaaf[o|u]aɖa awalaj t[o|u] ɕia malalaj[o|u] [o|u]ɻi [o|u] miina [o|u]ɻi a
S.TRANSL: ＂啊呀，你看，它們來了！＂ ，他們母女倆開始用跑的
"Look, it's coming! We are dead meat!" The two of them ran back toward home.

S.FORM: to ma-la-láyo sira om-oli am, mapa-zeveng rana sira ori a.
S.PHON: t[o|u] malal*j[o|u] ʂira [o|u]m[o|u]li am mapaʐəvəŋ rana ʂira [o|u]ri a
S.FORM: to malalayo sira omoli am, mapazeveng rana sira ori a.
S.PHON: t[o|u] malalaj[o|u] ɕiɻa [o|u]m[o|u]li am maparəfəŋ ɻana ɕiɻa [o|u]ɻi a
S.TRANSL: 他們用跑的回家去，然後就趕緊把門關上
They kept on running, and when they got home they closed the door.

S.FORM: ma-níring o tazokok ori am, "yaten tamo rana sira aro a zipo-zipos ta am, ma-ngay tamo do ili,
S.PHON: man*riŋ [o|u] taʐ[o|u]k[o|u]k [o|u]ri am jatən tam[o|u] rana ʂira ar[o|u] a ʐip[o|u]ʐip[o|u]ʂ ta am maŋaj tam[o|u] ɖ[o|u] ili
S.FORM: maniring o tazokok ori am, "yaten tamo rana sira aro a zipozipos ta am, mangay tamo do ili,
S.PHON: maniɻiŋ [o|u] tar[o|u]k[o|u]k [o|u]ɻi am jatən tam[o|u] ɻana ɕiɻa aɻ[o|u] a rip[o|u]rip[o|u]ʂ ta am maŋaj tam[o|u] ɖ[o|u] ili
S.TRANSL: tazokok鳥說＂我們這群有親戚關係的tazokok鳥，大家一起到村莊去
The tazokok bird said, "We are all relatives (tazokok birds) with one another. Let's go to the village.

S.FORM: ciaha ta ko rana ka-teng-an o vahay da, ta ko ni-ma-cita sira,
S.PHON: ciaʁa ta k[o|u] rana katəŋan [o|u] vaʁaj ɖa ta k[o|u] nimacita ʂira
S.FORM: ciaha ta ko rana katengan o vahay da, ta ko nimacita sira,
S.PHON: ʨiaɰa ta k[o|u] ɻana katəŋan [o|u] faɰaj ɖa ta k[o|u] nimaʨita ɕiɻa
S.TRANSL: 我已經知道他們的住家。我看見他們了＂
It's OK! I already know where they live. I saw them.

S.FORM: ya asa ka ka-nak-an o ya ni-om-inara jiaken, tazokok! tazokok! koan na yaken am,
S.PHON: ja aʂa ka kanakan [o|u] ja ni[o|u]minara ʥiakən taʐ[o|u]k[o|u]k taʐ[o|u]k[o|u]k k[o|u]an na jakən am
S.FORM: ya asa ka kanakan o ya niominara jiaken, tazokok! tazokok! koan na yaken am,
S.PHON: ja aʂa ka kanakan [o|u] ja ni[o|u]minaɻa ʥiakən tar[o|u]k[o|u]k tar[o|u]k[o|u]k k[o|u]an na jakən am
S.TRANSL: 有一個小孩模仿我，學我＂tazokok, tazokok＂ 的叫
A child copied my 'tazokok, tazokok' call.

S.FORM: "ji abo ka-ji tamo i ang-sem-an so mata da i", "nohon a", ratateng am, aro rana sira ori a tazokok a om-oli do ili a.
S.PHON: ʥi ab[o|u] kaʥi tam[o|u] i aŋʂəman ʂ[o|u] mata ɖa i n[o|u]ʁ[o|u]n a ratatəŋ am ar[o|u] rana ʂira [o|u]ri a taʐ[o|u]k[o|u]k a [o|u]m[o|u]li ɖ[o|u] ili a
S.FORM: "ji abo kaji tamo i angseman so mata da i", "nohon a", ratateng am, aro rana sira ori a tazokok a omoli do ili a.
S.PHON: ʥi ab[o|u] kaʥi tam[o|u] i aŋʂəman ʂ[o|u] mata ɖa i n[o|u]ɰ[o|u]n a ɻatatəŋ am aɻ[o|u] ɻana ɕiɻa [o|u]ɻi a tar[o|u]k[o|u]k a [o|u]m[o|u]li ɖ[o|u] ili a
S.TRANSL: ＂我們非吃了他們的眼睛不可＂ ，＂是的＂ 。很多的tazokok鳥成群的飛去村莊
We must go eat their eyeballs raw." "All right!" the rest of the birds said. The group of tazokok birds went together toward the village.

S.FORM: "a wajin do jia o.", "o ya do jia o vahay da", to na manóm-an sira no ni-s-om-ozi ori a tazokok ori a.
S.PHON: a waʥin ɖ[o|u] ʥia [o|u] [o|u] ja ɖ[o|u] ʥia [o|u] vaʁaj ɖa t[o|u] na man*man ʂira n[o|u] niʂ[o|u]m[o|u]ʐi [o|u]ri a taʐ[o|u]k[o|u]k [o|u]ri a
S.FORM: "a wajin do jia o.", "o ya do jia o vahay da", to na manoman sira no nisomozi ori a tazokok ori a.
S.PHON: a waʥin ɖ[o|u] ʥia [o|u] [o|u] ja ɖ[o|u] ʥia [o|u] faɰaj ɖa t[o|u] na man[o|u]man ɕiɻa n[o|u] niʂ[o|u]m[o|u]ri [o|u]ɻi a tar[o|u]k[o|u]k [o|u]ɻi a
S.TRANSL: ＂他們的 在哪裡？＂ 那隻生氣的tazokok鳥領著它們說；＂就是這一家了＂
"Where are they?" "This is their house," the angry bird that led them said.

S.FORM: ratateng am, "o ya o vahay da, da ni-sdep-an no ka-nak-an ang", "nohon".
S.PHON: ratatəŋ am [o|u] ja [o|u] vaʁaj ɖa ɖa niʂɖəpan n[o|u] kanakan aŋ n[o|u]ʁ[o|u]n
S.FORM: ratateng am, "o ya o vahay da, da nisdepan no kanakan ang", "nohon".
S.PHON: ɻatatəŋ am [o|u] ja [o|u] faɰaj ɖa ɖa niʂɖəpan n[o|u] kanakan aŋ n[o|u]ɰ[o|u]n
S.TRANSL: ＂這就是他們的家，小孩子就是進入了這個家＂ ＂是的＂
"This is the house. The kid went in here." "Yes."

S.FORM: karaan am, s-om-dep sira am, ni-slet-an da o vahay da.
S.PHON: karaan am ʂ[o|u]mɖəp ʂira am niʂlətan ɖa [o|u] vaʁaj ɖa
S.FORM: karaan am, somdep sira am, nisletan da o vahay da.
S.PHON: kaɻaan am ʂ[o|u]mɖəp ɕiɻa am niʂlətan ɖa [o|u] faɰaj ɖa
S.TRANSL: 於是它們就要進屋裡去，但門已鎖上
They tried to get in, but the door was locked.

S.FORM: "a ma-kong takamo so wajin ya, da ni-mímin a ni-sle-slet-an o vahay da ito?".
S.PHON: a mak[o|u]ŋ takam[o|u] ʂ[o|u] waʥin ja ɖa nim*min a niʂləʂlətan [o|u] vaʁaj ɖa it[o|u]
S.FORM: "a makong takamo so wajin ya, da nimimin a nislesletan o vahay da ito?".
S.PHON: a mak[o|u]ŋ takam[o|u] ʂ[o|u] waʥin ja ɖa nimimin a niʂləʂlətan [o|u] faɰaj ɖa it[o|u]
S.TRANSL: ＂我們怎麼辦？他們已經把所有的門都鎖上了＂
"What can we do? They have locked all the doors."

S.FORM: ikongodo anito pa nokakoa, to sia maci-siri-síring a, ma-teneng pa sira a mi-ziziak o tazokok ori a.
S.PHON: ik[o|u]ŋ[o|u]ɖ[o|u] anit[o|u] pa n[o|u]kak[o|u]a t[o|u] ʂia maciʂiriʂ*riŋ a matənəŋ pa ʂira a miʐiʐiak [o|u] taʐ[o|u]k[o|u]k [o|u]ri a
S.FORM: ikongodo anito pa nokakoa, to sia macisirisiring a, mateneng pa sira a miziziak o tazokok ori a.
S.PHON: ik[o|u]ŋ[o|u]ɖ[o|u] anit[o|u] pa n[o|u]kak[o|u]a t[o|u] ɕia maʨiɕiɻiɕiɻiŋ a matənəŋ pa ɕiɻa a miririak [o|u] tar[o|u]k[o|u]k [o|u]ɻi a
S.TRANSL: 由於早期還是鬼的世界，tazokok不只會說人話，還能與人類溝通
Because the early days were the days of the ghosts, the birds not only were able to communicate with people, but they also could speak in human tongue.

S.FORM: "na, no k-om-oan am, kabkab-en takamo o vahay da, me, me, tazokok! kabkab-en takamo o vahay da",
S.PHON: na n[o|u] k[o|u]m[o|u]an am kabkabən takam[o|u] [o|u] vaʁaj ɖa mə mə taʐ[o|u]k[o|u]k kabkabən takam[o|u] [o|u] vaʁaj ɖa
S.FORM: "na, no komoan am, kabkaben takamo o vahay da, me, me, tazokok! kabkaben takamo o vahay da",
S.PHON: na n[o|u] k[o|u]m[o|u]an am kabkabən takam[o|u] [o|u] faɰaj ɖa mə mə tar[o|u]k[o|u]k kabkabən takam[o|u] [o|u] faɰaj ɖa
S.TRANSL: ＂這樣吧，我們拆掉他們的屋頂。嗯，嗯，tazokok，我們掀開他們的屋頂＂
"If this is so, then we might as well tear open their roof. Un, un, tazokok, let's tear open their roof."

S.FORM: to rana a-cita o pakaw ori am, to sia rana andep a, "me, me, wajin sira do jia" koan da,
S.PHON: t[o|u] rana acita [o|u] pakaw [o|u]ri am t[o|u] ʂia rana anɖəp a mə mə waʥin ʂira ɖ[o|u] ʥia k[o|u]an ɖa
S.FORM: to rana acita o pakaw ori am, to sia rana andep a, "me, me, wajin sira do jia" koan da,
S.PHON: t[o|u] ɻana aʨita [o|u] pakaw [o|u]ɻi am t[o|u] ɕia ɻana anɖəp a mə mə waʥin ɕiɻa ɖ[o|u] ʥia k[o|u]an ɖa
S.TRANSL: 屋頂掀開以後，天花板就露了出來，它們就從天花板鑽進了屋裡。＂嗯，嗯，他們到哪裡去了？＂ 鳥說
After the roof was torn away, the ceiling showed, and they went through the ceiling into the house. "Un, un, where did they go?" the birds cried.

S.FORM: "me, me, kala-en tamo pala sira" koan da, kala-en da sira am ma-kala da sira,
S.PHON: mə mə kalaən tam[o|u] pala ʂira k[o|u]an ɖa kalaən ɖa ʂira am makala ɖa ʂira
S.FORM: "me, me, kalaen tamo pala sira" koan da, kalaen da sira am makala da sira,
S.PHON: mə mə kalaən tam[o|u] pala ɕiɻa k[o|u]an ɖa kalaən ɖa ɕiɻa am makala ɖa ɕiɻa
S.TRANSL: 它們說＂嗯，嗯，我們找找看＂ ，可是它們找遍了也找不著他們。
"Un, un, let's look for them," they said. They looked all over but couldn't find them.

S.FORM: karaan am, toktok-an da rana o mata da oso-en da, mimín-en da o mata da oso-en a.
S.PHON: karaan am t[o|u]kt[o|u]kan ɖa rana [o|u] mata ɖa [o|u]ʂ[o|u]ən ɖa mim*nən ɖa [o|u] mata ɖa [o|u]ʂ[o|u]ən a
S.FORM: karaan am, toktokan da rana o mata da osoen da, miminen da o mata da osoen a.
S.PHON: kaɻaan am t[o|u]kt[o|u]kan ɖa ɻana [o|u] mata ɖa [o|u]ʂ[o|u]ən ɖa miminən ɖa [o|u] mata ɖa [o|u]ʂ[o|u]ən a
S.TRANSL: 後來它們就開始啄他們的眼睛，把他們所有人的眼睛都挖起來吃
They gouged out all of their eyes.

S.FORM: asi-asisi da sira ori am, ikongo ji da ni-koi-koil do asi-asisi da.
S.PHON: aʂiaʂiʂi ɖa ʂira [o|u]ri am ik[o|u]ŋ[o|u] ʥi ɖa nik[o|u]ik[o|u]il ɖ[o|u] aʂiaʂiʂi ɖa
S.FORM: asiasisi da sira ori am, ikongo ji da nikoikoil do asiasisi da.
S.PHON: aɕiaɕiɕi ɖa ɕiɻa [o|u]ɻi am ik[o|u]ŋ[o|u] ʥi ɖa nik[o|u]ik[o|u]il ɖ[o|u] aɕiaɕiɕi ɖa
S.TRANSL: 就連他們的身上的肉也都挑（啄）起來
They even pulled off some of their flesh.

S.FORM: "beken, ji ko angay jimo a" koan na, "ji ka ngai, ta to mo ng-in-inára-i o tazokok".
S.PHON: bəkən ʥi k[o|u] aŋaj ʥim[o|u] a k[o|u]an na ʥi ka ŋai ta t[o|u] m[o|u] ŋinin*rai [o|u] taʐ[o|u]k[o|u]k
S.FORM: "beken, ji ko angay jimo a" koan na, "ji ka ngai, ta to mo ngininarai o tazokok".
S.PHON: bəkən ʥi k[o|u] aŋaj ʥim[o|u] a k[o|u]an na ʥi ka ŋai ta t[o|u] m[o|u] ŋininaɻai [o|u] tar[o|u]k[o|u]k
S.TRANSL: ＂不，我要跟你去＂ 小孩說，＂你不要來，你會模仿tazokok鳥叫聲＂
"No, I want to go with you," the child said. "Don't come, for you will copy the call of a tazokok bird."

S.FORM: "nohon, me, me, kabkab-en takamo" koan da am to da ngabkab-i ori a.
S.PHON: n[o|u]ʁ[o|u]n mə mə kabkabən takam[o|u] k[o|u]an ɖa am t[o|u] ɖa ŋabkabi [o|u]ri a
S.FORM: "nohon, me, me, kabkaben takamo" koan da am to da ngabkabi ori a.
S.PHON: n[o|u]ɰ[o|u]n mə mə kabkabən takam[o|u] k[o|u]an ɖa am t[o|u] ɖa ŋabkabi [o|u]ɻi a
S.TRANSL: ＂好！嗯，嗯，我們掀掉他們的屋頂＂ 它們說。它們就掀開了他們的屋頂
"Okay, un, un, we'll tear open their roof," they said, and they tore open the roof.

S.FORM: "me, me, vawa-en tamo pala o kazapaz an", vawa-en da o kazapaz am, ma-dpon sira dang ori a.
S.PHON: mə mə vawaən tam[o|u] pala [o|u] kaʐapaʐ an vawaən ɖa [o|u] kaʐapaʐ am maɖp[o|u]n ʂira ɖaŋ [o|u]ri a
S.FORM: "me, me, vawaen tamo pala o kazapaz an", vawaen da o kazapaz am, madpon sira dang ori a.
S.PHON: mə mə fawaən tam[o|u] pala [o|u] karapar an fawaən ɖa [o|u] karapar am maɖp[o|u]n ɕiɻa ɖaŋ [o|u]ɻi a
S.TRANSL: ＂嗯，嗯，我們掀開這個竹篩＂ ，他們就把竹篩掀開來一看，原來他們全部都集中在竹篩底下
"Un, un, let's look under the sifter made of bamboo." When they looked underneath, they found the entire family under there.

S.FORM: karaan am, akpeh-en da rana do kazapaz ori ori am, i-salap da rana no aro a tazokok o asisi da am mata-mata da asa ka vahay ori, ori o kavavatanen no tazokok.
S.PHON: karaan am akpəʁən ɖa rana ɖ[o|u] kaʐapaʐ [o|u]ri [o|u]ri am iʂalap ɖa rana n[o|u] ar[o|u] a taʐ[o|u]k[o|u]k [o|u] aʂiʂi ɖa am matamata ɖa aʂa ka vaʁaj [o|u]ri [o|u]ri [o|u] kavavatanən n[o|u] taʐ[o|u]k[o|u]k
S.FORM: karaan am, akpehen da rana do kazapaz ori ori am, isalap da rana no aro a tazokok o asisi da am matamata da asa ka vahay ori, ori o kavavatanen no tazokok.
S.PHON: kaɻaan am akpəɰən ɖa ɻana ɖ[o|u] karapar [o|u]ɻi [o|u]ɻi am iʂalap ɖa ɻana n[o|u] aɻ[o|u] a tar[o|u]k[o|u]k [o|u] aɕiɕi ɖa am matamata ɖa aʂa ka faɰaj [o|u]ɻi [o|u]ɻi [o|u] kafafatanən n[o|u] tar[o|u]k[o|u]k
S.TRANSL: tazokok把挖（啄）掉的眼睛，還有他們一家人的肉都集中放在竹篩裡帶著飛走了。這就是tazokok的故事
Tazokok placed all the eyeballs and flesh on the bamboo sifter and flew away with them. This is the story of the tazokok.
